Circular plots with F/B ratio

```{r donut phyla plots, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)  # for percent_format()
library(tibble)  # for rownames_to_column()
library(RColorBrewer)


# === 1. Filter samples for selected time points and prune taxa ===
included_timepoints <- c("T0", "T2", "T3", "T6")
ps_filtered <- subset_samples(ps, Time_Point %in% included_timepoints)
ps_filtered <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_filtered) > 0, ps_filtered)

# === 2. Agglomerate to Phylum level ===
ps_phylum <- tax_glom(ps_filtered, taxrank = "Phylum")

# === 3. Clean and fix taxonomy table ===
tax_mat <- as.matrix(tax_table(ps_phylum))
tax_mat[, "Phylum"] <- trimws(tax_mat[, "Phylum"])
tax_mat[, "Phylum"][tax_mat[, "Phylum"] == "none"] <- "Other"

# Replace tax table in phyloseq object
tax_table(ps_phylum) <- tax_table(tax_mat)

# === 4. Define phyla and color palette ===
phyla_all <- sort(unique(tax_mat[, "Phylum"]))
if (!"Other" %in% phyla_all) phyla_all <- c(phyla_all, "Other")

n_colors <- length(phyla_all)
n_colors <- max(3, min(12, n_colors))  # Brewer palettes support 3-12 colors

palette_colors <- brewer.pal(n_colors, "Set3")
phylum_colors <- setNames(palette_colors[1:length(phyla_all)], phyla_all)

# === 5. Prepare relative abundance data for plotting ===
otu_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_phylum), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_phylum)) otu_rel <- t(otu_rel)
otu_rel_df <- as.data.frame(otu_rel) %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID")

tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_phylum)) %>% rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_phylum))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)

# Join OTU relative abundance, taxonomy, and sample metadata
rel_abund_df <- otu_rel_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "FeatureID", values_to = "RelAbundance") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tax_df %>% dplyr::select(FeatureID, Phylum), by = "FeatureID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_df %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, TreatmentGroup, Time_Point), by = "SampleID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Phylum), !is.na(TreatmentGroup), !is.na(Time_Point))

# === 6. Summarize relative abundance per Phylum within each TreatmentGroup and Time_Point ===
library(dplyr)

# Define a threshold below which phyla are lumped into "Other"
threshold <- 0.005  # 1%

phylum_summary <- rel_abund_df %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(RelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point) %>%
  # Calculate total per group for normalization
  mutate(total_group = sum(RelAbundance)) %>%
  # Calculate proportion
  mutate(prop = RelAbundance / total_group) %>%
  # Mark low abundance phyla as "Other"
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(prop < threshold, "Other", Phylum)) %>%
  # Re-aggregate with "Other"
  group_by(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(RelAbundance = sum(RelAbundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point) %>%
  # Normalize again to make sure sums = 1
  mutate(RelAbundance = RelAbundance / sum(RelAbundance)) %>%
  arrange(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, desc(RelAbundance)) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(RelAbundance),
    ymin = ymax - RelAbundance,
    label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2
  )


# === 7. Fix factor levels to match color names ===
phylum_summary$Phylum <- factor(phylum_summary$Phylum, levels = names(phylum_colors))

# === 8. Plot faceted donut chart with matching colors ===
p_donut <- ggplot(phylum_summary, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 4, xmin = 3, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_rect(color = "black", size = 0.3) +   # black outline, adjust size as needed
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_grid(TreatmentGroup ~ Time_Point, switch = "y") +  # switch strips to left for rows
  xlim(c(2, 4)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",       # place facet labels outside the plot area
    strip.background = element_blank(), # remove strip background
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 11, face = "bold"), # style left strips
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  labs(title = "Relative Abundance of Phyla by Treatment and Time Point")

print(p_donut)


# === 9. Save plots ===
ggsave(file.path(root.dir, "phylum_donut_plots.pdf"), plot = p_donut, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(root.dir, "phylum_donut_plots.tiff"), plot = p_donut, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# Step 1: Prepare taxonomy table with trimmed Phylum names
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
  mutate(Phylum = trimws(as.character(Phylum)))

# Step 2: Filter Firmicutes and Bacteroidota features
firm_bact_ids <- tax_df %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% c("Firmicutes", "Bacteroidota")) %>%
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, Phylum)


# Step 3: Prepare OTU table in long format
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu_df <- t(otu_df)
}
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_df) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "FeatureID", values_to = "Abundance")

# Step 4: Join taxonomy to OTU data, keep only Firmicutes and Bacteroidota
otu_tax_df <- inner_join(otu_df, firm_bact_ids, by = "FeatureID")

# Step 5: Summarize abundance per SampleID and Phylum, pivot wider
otu_summarized <- otu_tax_df %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Phylum, values_from = TotalAbundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(FB_Ratio = Firmicutes / Bacteroidota)

# Step 6: Add sample metadata
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")
otu_summarized <- left_join(otu_summarized, sample_df, by = "SampleID")

# Step 7: Plot Firmicutes:Bacteroidota ratio over time by TreatmentGroup
# Make sure Time_Point is an ordered factor if you want ordered x-axis
otu_summarized$Time_Point <- factor(otu_summarized$Time_Point, levels = c("T0", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T6", "T8"))

p <- ggplot(otu_summarized, aes(x = Time_Point, y = FB_Ratio, color = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = TreatmentGroup), size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Firmicutes to Bacteroidota Ratio Over Time",
    x = "Time Point",
    y = "Firmicutes / Bacteroidota Ratio"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25, margin = margin(b = 15)),  # bigger title & margin below
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.8, "lines"),   # increase spacing here# legend title size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 22)        # legend item text size
  )



print(p)

# Save plots
ggsave(filename = file.path(root.dir, "Firmicutes_Bacteroidota_Ratio.pdf"), plot = p, device = "pdf", width = 30, height = 20)
ggsave(filename = file.path(root.dir, "Firmicutes_Bacteroidota_Ratio.tiff"), plot = p, device = "tiff", dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 6)
```

# Relative abundance bar charts at multiple taxonomic ranks
# Requires: ps (phyloseq object), root.dir defined
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Ranks to plot
rank_vec <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")

# Output directory
ra_dir <- file.path(root.dir, "Relative_Abundance_Barplots")
if (!dir.exists(ra_dir)) dir.create(ra_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Make sure these sample vars exist (otherwise remove from aes below)
sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup <- factor(sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup)
sample_data(ps)$Time_Point     <- factor(sample_data(ps)$Time_Point)

for (rk in rank_vec) {
  message("Processing rank: ", rk)

  # Skip if rank not present in taxonomy table
  if (!(rk %in% colnames(tax_table(ps)))) {
    message("  - Rank ", rk, " not found in tax_table(ps); skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Agglomerate to this taxonomic rank
  ps_rank <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = rk)
  ps_rank <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_rank) > 0, ps_rank)

  # Convert to relative abundance
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_rank, function(x) x / sum(x))

  # Extract data to long format
  phy_df <- psmelt(ps_rel)  # phyloseq -> data.frame
  # phy_df columns include: Sample, Abundance, rk, TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, etc.

  # Clean taxon names: replace NA / empty / "none" / "unclassified" with "Unclassified"
  phy_df[[rk]] <- as.character(phy_df[[rk]])
  phy_df[[rk]][is.na(phy_df[[rk]]) |
               phy_df[[rk]] == "" |
               tolower(phy_df[[rk]]) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"
  
  # Optionally group low-abundance taxa into "Other"
  # Here we define low-abundance taxa by mean rel. abundance across all samples
  tax_means <- phy_df %>%
    group_by(.data[[rk]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Keep top N taxa, others -> "Other"
  topN <- 15
  top_taxa <- tax_means %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
    slice_head(n = topN) %>%
    pull(.data[[rk]])

  phy_df[[rk]] <- ifelse(phy_df[[rk]] %in% top_taxa, phy_df[[rk]], "Other")
  phy_df[[rk]] <- factor(phy_df[[rk]])

  # Order samples by TreatmentGroup and Time_Point for nicer plotting
  phy_df <- phy_df %>%
    arrange(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, Sample)

  phy_df$Sample <- factor(phy_df$Sample, levels = unique(phy_df$Sample))

  # Build bar plot: each bar = sample, stacked by taxon at this rank
  p_ra <- ggplot(phy_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = .data[[rk]])) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_grid(~ Time_Point, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Relative Abundance at", rk, "Level"),
      x = "Sample (grouped by Time_Point)",
      y = "Relative Abundance",
      fill = rk
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines")
    )

  # Save plots
  out_pdf <- file.path(ra_dir, paste0("Relative_Abundance_", rk, ".pdf"))
  out_png <- file.path(ra_dir, paste0("Relative_Abundance_", rk, ".png"))

  ggsave(out_pdf, plot = p_ra, width = 12, height = 6)
  ggsave(out_png, plot = p_ra, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
message("✅ Relative abundance barplots saved in: ", ra_dir)
```

# Relative abundance bar charts at multiple taxonomic ranks
# Averaged across samples within TreatmentGroup x Time_Point
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

rank_vec <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")

ra_dir <- file.path(root.dir, "Relative_Abundance_Barplots_Averaged")
if (!dir.exists(ra_dir)) dir.create(ra_dir, recursive = TRUE)

sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup <- factor(sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup)
sample_data(ps)$Time_Point     <- factor(sample_data(ps)$Time_Point)

for (rk in rank_vec) {
  message("Processing rank: ", rk)

  if (!(rk %in% colnames(tax_table(ps)))) {
    message("  - Rank ", rk, " not found in tax_table(ps); skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Agglomerate to rank
  ps_rank <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = rk)
  ps_rank <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_rank) > 0, ps_rank)

  # Relative abundance per sample
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_rank, function(x) x / sum(x))

  phy_df <- psmelt(ps_rel)

  # Clean taxon names
  phy_df[[rk]] <- as.character(phy_df[[rk]])
  phy_df[[rk]][is.na(phy_df[[rk]]) |
               phy_df[[rk]] == "" |
               tolower(phy_df[[rk]]) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"

  # --- choose top taxa and relabel others as "Other" ---
  tax_means <- phy_df %>%
    group_by(.data[[rk]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  topN <- 15
  top_taxa <- tax_means %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
    slice_head(n = topN) %>%
    pull(.data[[rk]])

  phy_df[[rk]] <- ifelse(phy_df[[rk]] %in% top_taxa, phy_df[[rk]], "Other")

  # --- CRITICAL STEP: collapse within each sample after relabeling ---
  phy_df_collapsed <- phy_df %>%
    group_by(Sample, TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, .data[[rk]]) %>%
    summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

  # Check that within each sample sums ~1
  # (optional sanity check)
  # phy_df_collapsed %>%
  #   group_by(Sample) %>%
  #   summarise(total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  #   print(n = 10)

  # --- now average across samples within TreatmentGroup x Time_Point ---
  df_avg <- phy_df_collapsed %>%
    group_by(TreatmentGroup, Time_Point, .data[[rk]]) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples  = n_distinct(Sample),
      .groups    = "drop"
    )

  df_avg$TreatmentGroup <- factor(df_avg$TreatmentGroup,
                                  levels = levels(sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup))
  df_avg$Time_Point <- factor(df_avg$Time_Point,
                              levels = levels(sample_data(ps)$Time_Point))

  # Stacked bars: one per TreatmentGroup, faceted by Time_Point
p_ra <- ggplot(df_avg, aes(x = TreatmentGroup, y = mean_abund, fill = .data[[rk]])) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ Time_Point) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Relative Abundance at", rk, "Level (Averaged by Treatment x Time_Point)"),
    x = "Treatment Group",
    y = "Mean Relative Abundance",
    fill = rk
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = NaturePastel_palette) +   # ← ADD THIS
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )


  out_pdf <- file.path(ra_dir, paste0("Relative_Abundance_Averaged_", rk, ".pdf"))
  out_png <- file.path(ra_dir, paste0("Relative_Abundance_Averaged_", rk, ".png"))

  ggsave(out_pdf, plot = p_ra, width = 10, height = 5)
  ggsave(out_png, plot = p_ra, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}

message("✅ Averaged relative abundance barplots saved in: ", ra_dir)

```


## Top genera per treatment: time-course barplots + stats + p-value brackets
## Each plot: one genus, one treatment, bars over Time_Point, with Nature Pastel colors
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# Nature Pastel palette (20 colors)
nature_pastel <- c(
  "#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e",
  "#e6ab02", "#a6761d", "#666666", "#1f78b4", "#b2df8a",
  "#fb9a99", "#fdbf6f", "#cab2d6", "#ffff99", "#b15928",
  "#8dd3c7", "#bebada", "#fb8072", "#80b1d3", "#fdb462"
)

# Basic factors
sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup <- factor(sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup)
sample_data(ps)$Time_Point     <- factor(sample_data(ps)$Time_Point)

# Output root
top_genus_root <- file.path(root.dir, "Top_Genus_Timecourse_WithStats")
if (!dir.exists(top_genus_root)) dir.create(top_genus_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Parameters
rank_name <- "Genus"
topN      <- 10   # how many top genera per treatment to analyze/plot

# Loop over treatments
treatments <- levels(sample_data(ps)$TreatmentGroup)

for (treat in treatments) {
  message("===== Treatment: ", treat, " =====")

  # Directory for this treatment
  treat_dir <- file.path(top_genus_root, paste0("Treatment_", treat))
  if (!dir.exists(treat_dir)) dir.create(treat_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Subset to this treatment
  ps_treat <- subset_samples(ps, TreatmentGroup == treat)
  ps_treat <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_treat) > 0, ps_treat)

  if (nsamples(ps_treat) < 2) {
    message("  - Not enough samples; skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Agglomerate to Genus
  ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_treat, taxrank = rank_name)
  ps_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_genus) > 0, ps_genus)

  # Relative abundance
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

  # Long data
  df <- psmelt(ps_rel)   # columns: Sample, Abundance, Genus, Time_Point, TreatmentGroup, ...

  # Clean genus names
  df[[rank_name]] <- as.character(df[[rank_name]])
  df[[rank_name]][is.na(df[[rank_name]]) |
                  df[[rank_name]] == "" |
                  tolower(df[[rank_name]]) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"

  # Choose top genera in this treatment (by mean abundance across all samples/timepoints)
  top_genera <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[rank_name]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
    slice_head(n = topN) %>%
    pull(.data[[rank_name]])

  if (length(top_genera) == 0) {
    message("  - No genera to analyze; skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Containers for plots and stats
  plot_list <- list()
  stats_list <- list()

  # Loop over top genera
  for (i in seq_along(top_genera)) {
    genus_i <- top_genera[i]
    message("  * Genus: ", genus_i)

    df_g <- df %>%
      filter(.data[[rank_name]] == genus_i)

    # If genus never appears (shouldn't happen), skip
    if (nrow(df_g) == 0) next

    # Summary for bar heights (mean ± SEM) per time point
    summary_g <- df_g %>%
      group_by(Time_Point) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_abund   = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        n          = n(),
        se_abund   = sd_abund / sqrt(n),
        .groups    = "drop"
      )

    # ---- Statistics across time points ----
    # Kruskal–Wallis test (robust for non-normal rel. abundances)
    kw <- tryCatch(
      df_g %>% kruskal_test(Abundance ~ Time_Point),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    # Pairwise Wilcoxon test if KW is significant at 0.05
    pwc_sig <- NULL
    if (!is.null(kw) && nrow(kw) > 0 && !is.na(kw$p) && kw$p < 0.05) {
      pwc <- df_g %>%
        pairwise_wilcox_test(
          Abundance ~ Time_Point,
          p.adjust.method = "BH"
        )

      pwc_sig <- pwc %>%
        filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
        arrange(p.adj)

      if (nrow(pwc_sig) > 0) {
        # Limit number of brackets to avoid clutter (e.g., top 4)
        pwc_sig <- pwc_sig %>%
          slice_head(n = 4)

        # Compute y positions for brackets
        y_max <- max(summary_g$mean_abund, na.rm = TRUE)
        # small offsets above the max bar
        pwc_sig <- pwc_sig %>%
          mutate(
            y.position = y_max + seq(0.02, 0.02 * n(), by = 0.02),
            label = paste0("p = ", signif(p.adj, 2)),
            group = row_number()
          )
      }
      # Save pairwise stats
      if (nrow(pwc) > 0) {
        stats_list[[length(stats_list) + 1]] <- pwc %>%
          mutate(
            Treatment   = treat,
            Genus       = genus_i,
            global_kw_p = kw$p
          )
      }
    } else {
      # Even if KW not sig, record its p
      stats_list[[length(stats_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        Treatment   = treat,
        Genus       = genus_i,
        group1      = NA_character_,
        group2      = NA_character_,
        p           = NA_real_,
        p.adj       = NA_real_,
        p.adj.signif = NA_character_,
        method      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
        global_kw_p = if (!is.null(kw)) kw$p else NA_real_
      )
    }

    # ---- Choose a consistent color for this genus from Nature Pastel ----
    color_idx <- (i - 1) %% length(nature_pastel) + 1
    genus_color <- nature_pastel[color_idx]
    fill_vals <- setNames(genus_color, genus_i)

    # ---- Plot: mean ± SE over time, one bar per timepoint ----
    p <- ggplot(summary_g,
                aes(x = Time_Point, y = mean_abund, fill = genus_i)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_abund - se_abund, 0),
                        ymax = mean_abund + se_abund),
                    width = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals, guide = "none") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
        limits = c(0, min(1, max(summary_g$mean_abund + summary_g$se_abund, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Treatment: ", treat,
                       " | Genus: ", genus_i),
        x = "Time Point",
        y = "Mean Relative Abundance"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      )

    # Add p-value brackets, if any significant pairs
    if (!is.null(pwc_sig) && nrow(pwc_sig) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
          pwc_sig,
          label = "label",
          y.position = "y.position",
          xmin = "group1",
          xmax = "group2",
          tip.length = 0.01,
          bracket.size = 0.3,
          size = 3
        )
    }

    plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p
  }

  # ---- Save multi-page PDF of all genus plots for this treatment ----
  if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
    pdf(file.path(treat_dir, "Top_Genera_Timecourse_with_stats.pdf"),
        width = 7, height = 5)
    for (p in plot_list) print(p)
    dev.off()
  }

  # ---- Save stats CSV for this treatment ----
  if (length(stats_list) > 0) {
    stats_treat <- bind_rows(stats_list)
    write.csv(
      stats_treat,
      file = file.path(treat_dir, "Top_Genera_Timecourse_stats.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

message("✅ Finished: per-treatment genus time-course plots + stats saved under:\n",
        top_genus_root, "\n")
```

###Below for Functional Predictions from 16S

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)

out_dir <- "PICRUSt2_from_phyloseq"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Make sure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) ps <- t(ps)

# 1A) FASTA (headers = ASV IDs). Use safe, short IDs (PICRUSt2-friendly).
asv_ids <- paste0("ASV_", seq_len(ntaxa(ps)))
seqs <- taxa_names(ps)

fasta_path <- file.path(out_dir, "asv_rep_seqs.fasta")
con <- file(fasta_path, "w")
for (i in seq_along(seqs)) {
  writeLines(paste0(">", asv_ids[i]), con)
  writeLines(seqs[i], con)
}
close(con)

# 1B) Count table (samples x ASVs) with matching ASV IDs as column names
asv_mat <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")  # taxa x samples
rownames(asv_mat) <- asv_ids            # replace long DNA names with ASV_#
asv_mat <- t(asv_mat)                   # samples x taxa

asv_tsv <- file.path(out_dir, "asv_table.tsv")
write.table(asv_mat, asv_tsv, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = NA)

# 1C) Save an ID→sequence key (handy for interpreting later)
key_path <- file.path(out_dir, "ASV_id_to_sequence.tsv")
write.table(data.frame(ASV_ID = asv_ids, Sequence = seqs),
            key_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

cat("Wrote:\n", fasta_path, "\n", asv_tsv, "\n", key_path, "\n")

```

16s and metabolomics integration 

```{r}
# ============================================================
# STEP 1 — Define the single pre-challenge time point + subset
# Requires: ps already exists
# Output: ps_pre, meta_pre
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# --- set your pre-challenge time point label here ---
pre_tp <- "T6"   # change if needed (e.g., "T3")

# Subset to the one time point
ps_pre <- subset_samples(ps, Time_Point == pre_tp)
ps_pre <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_pre) > 0, ps_pre)

# Pull metadata (keep SampleID explicit)
meta_pre <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_pre), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = as.character(SampleID),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup),
    Time_Point = as.character(Time_Point)
  )

# Quick checks
cat("Time point kept:", pre_tp, "\n")
cat("N samples at pre-challenge:", nsamples(ps_pre), "\n")
print(table(meta_pre$TreatmentGroup))
stopifnot(all(meta_pre$SampleID %in% sample_names(ps_pre)))
```
